title: Cardamonin targets KEAP1/NRF2 signaling for protection against atherosclerosis.
authors: Fan, Pengfei; Meng, Huali; Hao, Wenhao; Zheng, Yan; Li, Hui; Zhang, Zhiyue; Du, Lei; Guo, Xin; Wang, Dongliang; Wang, Yunyan; Wu, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究豆蔻明通过KEAP1/NRF2信号通路抗动脉粥样硬化，仅涉及分子对接预测小分子与蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合位点或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Atherosclerosis (AS)-induced cardiovascular disease is a leading cause of death worldwide. To date, there is still a lack of effective approaches for AS intervention. Cardamonin (CAD) is a bioactive food component, but its effect on AS is unknown. In this work, CAD was investigated for its effect on AS using low-density lipoprotein receptor knockout mice and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha)-stimulated endothelial cells (ECs). After a 12-week intervention, CAD was found to significantly prevent AS formation in the aortic root and aortic tree, reduce the necrotic core area, and inhibit aortic inflammation and oxidative stress. Moreover, CAD quenched TNF-alpha-provoked inflammation and oxidative stress in ECs. RNA-sequencing identified nuclear factor erythroid-2 related factor 2 (NFE2L2, NRF2)/heme oxidase 1 (HO1) signaling to be drastically activated by CAD. CAD is a known activator of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) which is a transcription factor of the NFE2L2 gene. Surprisingly, AHR was not required for CAD's action on the activation of NRF2/HO1 signaling since AHR gene silencing did not reverse this effect. Furthermore, a molecular docking assay showed a strong binding potential of CAD to the Kelch domain of the Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (KEAP1) which sequesters NRF2 in the cytoplasm. Both CAD and the Kelch domain inhibitor Ki696 promoted NRF2 nuclear translocation, whereas the combination of CAD and Ki696 did not yield a greater effect compared with either CAD or Ki696, confirming the interaction of CAD with the Kelch domain. This work provides an experimental basis for CAD as a novel and effective bioactive food component in future AS interventions.
abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化（AS）诱导的心血管疾病是全球主要的死亡原因。迄今为止，仍缺乏有效的AS干预手段。豆蔻明（Cardamonin, CAD）是一种生物活性食品成分，但其对AS的作用尚不清楚。本研究利用低密度脂蛋白受体敲除小鼠和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）刺激的内皮细胞（ECs），探讨了CAD对AS的影响。经过12周的干预，发现CAD能显著预防主动脉根部和主动脉树的AS形成，减少坏死核心区域，并抑制主动脉炎症和氧化应激。此外，CAD还抑制了TNF-alpha诱导的ECs炎症和氧化应激。RNA测序鉴定出核因子E2相关因子2（NFE2L2, NRF2）/血红素加氧酶1（HO1）信号通路被CAD显著激活。CAD是芳烃受体（AHR）的已知激活剂，而AHR是NFE2L2基因的转录因子。令人惊讶的是，AHR并非CAD激活NRF2/HO1信号通路所必需，因为AHR基因沉默并未逆转这一效应。进一步地，分子对接实验显示CAD与Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（KEAP1）的Kelch结构域有强结合潜力，该结构域在细胞质中隔离NRF2。CAD和Kelch结构域抑制剂Ki696均促进了NRF2核转位，而CAD与Ki696联合使用并未比单独使用CAD或Ki696产生更大效果，证实了CAD与Kelch结构域的相互作用。本研究为CAD作为未来AS干预中新型有效的生物活性食品成分提供了实验依据。
